purpose: Floating-point reproduction of explicit feasible-pair lower bounds; no global optimization or interval certificate.

definitions.positivity_justification: The proved sup bound |u_m| <= C_u and the stated amplitude caps guarantee p >= 1/2 everywhere.
definitions.budget_justification: The amplitude minimum enforces t ||u_m||_2 ||v||_2 <= epsilon or t ||u_m||_2^2 <= epsilon.
